cards.title: Nvidia Pauses Chip Shipments to Southeast Asia
cards.body: Nvidia has instructed manufacturing partners to halt server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia. The move aligns with U.S. efforts to prevent AI chips from reaching China.

cards.title: GTA VI Launch Outshines AI Efficiency Push
cards.body: Grand Theft Auto VI became one of entertainment's most successful launches on the same day Anthropic went public. The painstakingly human-made game proved that efficiency isn't always the ultimate virtue.

cards.title: S&P Eyes Nvidia Credit Downgrade
cards.body: Standard & Poor's is considering lowering Nvidia's credit rating to AA-, citing governance and 'key man' risks. The potential downgrade reflects concerns about leadership concentration at the chip giant.

cards.title: OpenAI Merges Chat and Work Plans
cards.body: OpenAI is introducing a unified usage meter across ChatGPT as it combines Chat and Work experiences. Heavy users may hit their limits sooner under the new consolidated system.

cards.title: Jensen Huang Violated Nvidia Code of Conduct
cards.body: Nvidia's founder broke the company's own code of conduct, potentially signaling deeper cultural issues. Employees may face challenges reconciling the incident with corporate governance standards.

cards.title: Anthropic CEO Defends Human Control Stance
cards.body: Dario Amodei dismissed accusations that Anthropic favors surrendering human agency to AI as 'absurd.' This comes as leading AI companies increasingly automate research and model development.

cards.title: New York Bans AI Chatbot Toys
cards.body: New York has implemented a five-year ban on AI chatbot toys following safety research revealing troubling failures. Common Sense Media found risks including inappropriate content exposure and emotional development concerns.

cards.title: State AGs Challenge Character.AI Data Auction
cards.body: State attorneys general are challenging Character.ai's bankruptcy plan to auction private chat data from 21 million U.S. accounts. Over 2.1 million accounts belonged to registered minors.

cards.title: AI Data Centers Harder to Build
cards.body: Nvidia won't back AI data centers until they're nearly operational, raising the bar for neocloudsto complete projects. The shift signals that physical infrastructure now matters more than ambitious pitch decks.

cards.title: Amazon and Meta Discuss Muse Blockade
cards.body: Amazon and Meta are negotiating a potential deal to end a two-month blockade of AI agent Muse. The resolution could restart integrations with major retailers.

cards.title: Investigators Focus on Megaspeed Chip Questions
cards.body: Authorities are investigating what Nvidia knew about where Megaspeed chips ultimately ended up. Jensen Huang's relationship with a Megaspeed executive raises questions about oversight and verification.

cards.title: Yale Professor Questions Nvidia's U.S. Role
cards.body: Yale's Jeffrey Sonnenfeld warns that Nvidia could become a 'detriment' to U.S. industrial strength, not a champion. He cautions that Huang's return as CEO poses 'historic' liability risks and raises governance concerns.

cards.title: Jensen Huang Resists Formal Succession Planning
cards.body: Nvidia's founder believes succession plans create unnecessary hierarchy, a stance criticized after recent leadership turmoil. The position reflects broader tensions over governance at the chip maker.

cards.title: Huang Apologizes at All-Hands Meeting
cards.body: Jensen Huang thanked the White House for his second chance to lead Nvidia and revealed he's in therapy. The founder apologized to employees and expressed gratitude for their support.

cards.title: Advanced AI Agents Struggle With Daily Tasks
cards.body: Even top-performing AI models fail to reliably complete everyday tasks without introducing new problems, new research shows. The benchmark reveals significant safety gaps as AI assistants reach mainstream adoption.

cards.title: Walmart Launches Black Friday Deals on Muse
cards.body: Walmart now enables customers to shop Black Friday deals directly through Meta's AI agent Muse. The partnership marks a significant retail use case for AI shopping assistants.

cards.title: Maple Raises $5.3M for Data Privacy
cards.body: Maple's encrypted AI architecture prevents even the company itself from accessing user data, a key privacy differentiator. The startup has secured $5.3M in funding to build privacy-first AI products.

cards.title: Anthropic Shares Fall Below IPO Price
cards.body: Anthropic's post-IPO stock slump signals potential headwinds for AI startup valuations across the sector. The decline may put pressure on fundraising and investor sentiment for emerging AI companies.

cards.title: UK Warns of AI-Driven Cyberattacks
cards.body: British cyber agencies report that AI-powered attacks exploit years of weak security foundations and simple flaws. Building robust defenses has become urgent as hacking tools leverage AI capabilities.

cards.title: Meta Integrates Muse AI Into Instagram DMs
cards.body: Meta's AI assistant Muse is now directly accessible within Instagram direct messages for seamless interaction. Users no longer need to switch between apps to engage with the AI agent.

cards.title: AI Straining America's Open Records Systems
cards.body: AI has intensified investor interest in public records, creating unprecedented strain on local government systems. Small towns like Panton, Vermont are struggling to manage AI-driven requests for data access.

cards.title: Data Centers Building Own Natural Gas Plants
cards.body: AI data centers are bypassing grid approval delays by building private gas power plants to fuel operations. This behind-the-meter approach sidesteps decade-long connection waits.

cards.title: AI Could Keep World Dependent on Natural Gas
cards.body: Rising AI electricity demands are driving a natural-gas boom, with data centers fueling the trend. Renewable alternatives struggle to meet the surge in power consumption.

cards.title: AI May Transform Theoretical Physics
cards.body: Machine learning is poised to fundamentally change how physicists conduct research and develop theories. AI tools could redefine what it means to be a theoretical physicist.

cards.title: Etsy Clarifies AI Policy After Seller Backlash
cards.body: Etsy updated its AI terms following significant pushback from sellers concerned about artificial intelligence use. The platform addressed community concerns about how AI impacts the marketplace.
